2. Mr. S.N. Goswami, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the defendants submitted joint written statement on 1.1.2009 and stated inter-alia the suit is bad for want of cause of action as well as statement of account. The claim is false. The learned Advocate further submits that on 15.1.2010 was fixed for framing issues and thereafter, the suit was transferred on 29.1.2009 and on that day the blastoff filed an application under section 13(3) of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 for judgment and the court allowed the application and decreed the suit on 23.2.2009. Thereafter, the decree holder bank started certain Artha Rin Jari Case No.175 of 2009 in the same court. 

 3. The learned Advocate further submits that the section 9(5) provides that if the defendants admit the claim or part of it should be stated in the written statement specifically and in that case the learned Judge can pass the decree as contemplated under section 13(3) but in the case the petitioner has not admitted the claim of the plaintiff rather specifically denied the claim in the written statement and as such Judgment dated 23.2.2009 passed by the Artha Rin Adalat without jurisdiction. The petitioner having been aggrieved by the order dated 23.2.2009 has filed this writ petition. 

 “কিন্তু বাদ পক্ষ সঠিকভাবে হিসাব দাখিল করেন নাই যাহা বাদী পক্ষ গোপন করিয়া এই মামলা দায়ের করিয়াছন”  and passing the order under section 13(3) of the Ain appears to have passed beyond the scope of the law. Since the defendant did not admit the claim of the plaintiff bank, the Artha Rin Adalat had no jurisdiction or power to dispose of the suits as per section 13 of Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 and as such the impugned judgments and decree have been passed without jurisdiction and is of no legal effect and the order dated 23.2.2009 is set aside.
